title: 第47章 恋爱的酸臭味，连长是战狼
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “哇塞，这就是团部嘛，好气派！”“这大楼，比俺们镇上那镇政府办公楼看着还要高，还要大！”“卧槽，快看，快看！这雕塑，真，真......牛逼！”孔垄看着特三团的大雕塑，想了半天形容词，都没能想得出来。奈何书读得少，只能是“卧槽，牛逼”走天下！运兵车缓缓开进团部，后头的围板放下来。新兵们鱼贯而出的揉着屁股，从里头下来。和陆阳刚到这的感受一样，到处都是军官，看的大家眼花缭乱。在新兵连，只有连长和指导员两个军官，所以大家理所应当的以为，军官在部队里是很稀少的。可到了这简直就像白菜一样稀疏平常，甚至还能瞧见校官走来走去。正当大家感慨时，陆阳一溜小跑的朝着这边走过来，跟大家一块集合。“报告班长，陆阳申请归队。”“好点儿了吗？”周凯东点点头，关心询问。陆阳笑着说：“好多了，昨天中午烧就已经退了；吃好睡好，上道跑个三公里都没问题。”周凯东叮嘱：“下回不准这么逞强，身体不舒服就歇会儿，训练急不在一时半会儿。”“是。”回到队伍里，孔垄等人也是一副笑嘻嘻的模样。“咋样，班副？”“啥？”“别装了，医务室里有没有好看的卫生员小姐姐？”“有没有小姐姐，脱你裤子，往你屁股上打针？”“小姐姐，有没有趁你睡着的时候，嘿嘿嘿.....”瞧见这帮人贼兮兮的猥琐模样，陆阳就知道这帮人没少艺术鉴赏那些乱七八糟的东西。“卫生员不一定就得是女的，也有不少男同志。”“那有没有男卫生员，趁你睡着的时候，嘿嘿嘿.....”“滚你妈蛋！”见陆阳气急败坏的模样，众人全部哈哈笑了。看到他这么有精神，和前两天生病判若两人，大家心里还挺高兴的。尽管陆阳的训练成绩并不是最好的，但绝对是班里最不可或缺的。因为他心智相对更加成熟，看待问题也更全面。他的存在，就像是新兵们和老兵班长之间的一个过渡缓冲带，能够很好的削弱班长愤怒时的火气。孔垄突然开口道：“昨个白天，班长中途去值班室接了个电话，回来就跟变了个人似的，我还真挺怀念前两天那温温和和的他。”陆阳会心一笑，知道是昨天打的那通电话起作用了。“昨天，班长跟你们开班务会了吗？”“没有啊？”陆阳愣住了：“那他，有没有说点儿什么？”孔垄摇头：“就说了今天要体检，早点休息，别的就没说了。”陆阳心咯噔一下，顿感大事不妙。周凯东没有私底下和大家通过气？那万一待会要是出现状况怎么办？他带着疑问目光看向周凯东，周凯东倒是没有回避，回了一个坦荡荡的微笑。尽管陆阳昨天的电话给了他极大安慰，可他这个班长称职不称职，还得新兵说了算。为人坦荡，是他周凯东的一向行事作风。如果上头要换他，自已带的兵也赞同，那走就走吧。......这时，连长的吉普车姗姗来迟，高峰下了车直接领着大家朝团部大楼东边走去。那边同样是一大块空地，有一排二层小楼，一楼空屋子里摆放着一张张桌子。正有穿白大褂的医护人员，在给人进行体检工作。楼前空地上，停靠着几辆大型卡车，车身除了迷彩涂装还有醒目的红色十字标识。这应该就是野战医院的流动体检车了。高峰冲着新兵们说：“咱们比预定时间早到了十分钟，前头还有些团里骨干和军属在体检。大家在原地等待通知，不准到处乱跑！”说罢，连长便带着包括周凯东在内的三位排长，去到楼里拿体检表，现场则交由指导员代为管理。“三班，跟我过来一下。”何镇涛把三班新兵单独叫到一旁。其余人全部一头雾水，只有陆阳心里清楚怎么回事。果不其然，何镇涛没有任何废话，开门见山的说起准备换班长的事儿。“这些天，你们班级纪律自由散漫，训练成绩下滑严重，内务卫生也不达标。”“有你们自身问题，但更多是你们班长的责任。”“这会严重影响到你们最终考核成绩，以及下连分配问题。”“所以，就目前情况来看，周凯东已经不再适合担任带兵班长职务。”听到这番话，新兵们面面相觑，压根就没料到还能中途换班长？没给大家讨论和商量的机会，何镇涛直接拿出一张张纸条和一把黑色笔芯。“不记名投票，同意换班长的打钩，不同意打叉，这样都不会有心理负担。”“是，全票通过的那吗？”“不，只要有一个人打钩，待会体检结束以后，周凯东就可以回去他的老部队了。”这样的投票方式，属实是有些霸道，众人一下子竟全都犯了难。而大家对于周凯东的印象也是不尽相同。有人觉得他在训练中过分严苛，动不动就大喊大叫，举止粗鲁。也有人喜欢前两天“和蔼可亲”的他，期盼着能换来一个好说话，能让大家睡懒觉的班长。也有想得比较多的，在思考如果换一个新班长过来，会不会还不如周凯东？陆阳倒是没丝毫犹豫，直接在纸条上画了一个叉，折好后交给了指导员。何镇涛并没有丝毫意外，他也知道昨天自已离开后，这小子肯定打电话给周凯东通过气。因为先前在来的路上，高峰告诉他昨天周凯东去值班室接了个电话，回来后态度就突然出现一百八十度转变。根据时间推断，十有八九是陆阳借旁人手机，打了电话回来。不过，何镇涛对此并不反感，生着病却还能惦记自已班长，说明这个兵有情有义。相反，如果陆阳什么都没做，他反而会觉得这个兵外热内冷，相对自我。但，一个人的决定，改变不了整体结果。规矩，是他和连长商量后定下的，只要有一个人想让周凯东走，那他就必须得走。这么做是为了三班新兵着想，正好也能将周凯东和丁腾飞之间的矛盾，来个一刀切。何镇涛将纸条全部收上来，却并没有立即打开，而是全部揣进口袋里，让大家先去体检。这就弄得，包括陆阳在内的所有人非常抓狂。明明立马就能揭晓答案，却非得弄个广告之后马上回来，这谁受得了？就跟看小说，有些狗作者总喜欢在关键时刻卡文一样，弄得人百爪挠心。“搞什么，现场拆不就知道结果了吗，非得等到体检完？”“哎，你们打得勾，还是叉，我反正是打的叉。”“我也是，我也是，我觉得咱班长其实人还蛮好的。”“好啥啊？凶死了，要是能换个像二班长那样好脾气的来多好，谁愿意天天挨骂？”“我靠，你不会打勾了吧？”“胡说八道，我，我打的也是叉！”这是一个说谎者的游戏，即便是真的打了勾的，也不会有人承认。来部队这么些天，大家也不再是什么都不懂的小白。被新兵连一脚踢出去，意味着新训任务出现变故，属于工作失职。未来评优评选，还有留队晋升，都会跟周凯东无缘；属于是一张票，就能断人家前程。这种事即便是真的干了，也得咬死不认，不然脊梁骨都得被人戳烂了。孔垄凑上来，小声问：“你说，丁腾飞那小子会不会打勾？”陆阳摇头：“不重要了。”“为啥？”“反正已经交上去了，现在讨论也没用，回头看结果吧。”“其实，我还蛮喜欢老周的，虽然下手真黑，但人是一点儿毛病没有！”陆阳嗯了一声，但并不是每个人都如他们所想。众口难调，即便你是钞票，也会碰上视金钱如粪土的人。这会儿，三位排长已经回来，把领到的体检表分发下去。周凯东明显知道发生了什么，但却依旧假装不知情，也没问过一句话。他像是完全看开了一般，好像对于最终结果并不怎么在乎似的。十分钟很快过去，排在前头的军属和团干部体检也告一段落，终于轮到他们这些新兵蛋子了。就在大家陆陆续续，准备排着队往楼里走时，忽然瞧见一个女中尉从旁边体检车里走出来。大家还是头回见着女兵，尽管形象气质并不算出众，但目光依旧会被那身女士军装吸引过去。紧接着，便瞧见这个女中尉走到了高峰身旁，轻轻拍了一下他的肩膀。两人有说有笑，看着关系就很不一般。高峰还从怀里取出热豆浆和两个包子递过去，明显是提前准备好的。“啧啧啧，我闻到了，恋爱的酸臭味儿。”“我也闻到了。”“真是没想到，咱连长瞧着那么霸气一人竟然是属狗的。”“啥狗？”“不是傻狗，是舔狗！”
content_en: "Wow, this is the regiment headquarters, so majestic!" "This building looks taller and bigger than the town government office building in our town!" "Holy shit, look at it, look at it! This sculpture is really, really... awesome!" Kong Long looked at the large sculpture of the Special Third Regiment and thought for a long time about the adjectives, but he couldn't think of any.However, I haven't read enough books, so I can only "fuck you, you're awesome" and go all over the world!The troop carrier slowly drove into the regiment headquarters, and the hoarding at the back was lowered.The new recruits filed out, rubbing their buttocks, and got out.Just like Lu Yang's feeling when he first arrived here, there were officers everywhere and everyone was dazzled.In the recruit company, there are only two officers, the company commander and the instructor, so everyone takes it for granted that officers are very rare in the army.But here it is as sparse and ordinary as cabbage, and you can even see school officials walking around.Just as everyone was sighing, Lu Yang trotted over and gathered with everyone."Report to the squad leader, Lu Yang applied to return to the team." "Are you feeling better?" Zhou Kaidong nodded and asked with concern.Lu Yang said with a smile: "It's much better. The fever went away at noon yesterday. If you eat well and sleep well, you can run three kilometers on the road without any problem." Zhou Kaidong warned: "Don't be so aggressive next time. If you feel uncomfortable, just take a rest. Training should not be rushed for a while." "Yes." Back in the team, Kong Long and others were also smiling."How are you, shift deputy?" "What?" "Stop pretending, is there a good-looking hygienist in the infirmary?" "Is there a young lady who can take off your pants and inject your butt?" "Sister, have you ever taken advantage of your sleep to, hey, hey, hey..." Seeing the sleazy and sleazy looks of this group of people, Lu Yang knew that these people had a lot of artistic appreciation for those messy things."The hygienist does not have to be female, there are also many gay men." "Are there any male hygienists? While you are asleep, hey hey hey..." "Get the hell out of here!" Seeing Lu Yang's furious look, everyone laughed.Everyone was quite happy to see that he was so energetic and completely different from when he was sick two days ago.Although Lu Yang's training results are not the best, he is definitely the most indispensable in the class.Because he is relatively more mature mentally and looks at problems more comprehensively.His presence is like a transitional buffer zone between the new recruits and the veteran squad leader, which can very well weaken the squad leader's anger when he is angry.Kong Long suddenly said: "Yesterday during the day, the squad leader went to the duty room to answer a phone call. When he came back, he seemed like a different person. I really miss him as gentle and gentle as he was two days ago." Lu Yang smiled knowingly, knowing that the call he made yesterday had an effect."Did the squad leader hold a class meeting with you yesterday?" "No?" Lu Yang was stunned: "Then, did he say anything?" Kong Long shook his head: "I just said that I would have a physical examination today and go to bed early, and nothing else." Lu Yang's heart skipped a beat, and he suddenly felt that something was wrong.Didn't Zhou Kaidong get angry with everyone in private?What if something happens later?He looked at Zhou Kaidong with questioning eyes, but Zhou Kaidong did not avoid it and responded with a magnanimous smile.Although Lu Yang's phone call yesterday gave him great comfort, the recruits had to decide whether he was qualified or not as a squad leader.Being magnanimous has always been Zhou Kaidong's behavior.If the superiors want to replace him and the soldiers you lead also agree, then go ahead....At this time, the company commander's jeep arrived belatedly. Gao Feng got out of the car and led everyone directly to the east of the regiment headquarters building.There is also a large open space over there, with a row of two-story buildings, and tables placed in the empty rooms on the first floor.There are medical staff in white coats conducting physical examinations on people.In the open space in front of the building, there are several large trucks parked. In addition to camouflage paint, there are eye-catching red cross logos on the bodies.This should be the mobile medical examination vehicle of the field hospital.Gao Feng said to the recruits: "We arrived ten minutes earlier than the scheduled time. There are still some key members of the regiment and military family members in front of us undergoing physical examinations. Everyone is waiting for the notice, and you are not allowed to run around!" After that, the company commander took the three platoon leaders, including Zhou Kaidong, to the building to get the physical examination form, and the scene was managed by the instructor."Class 3, come with me." He Zhentao called the recruits from Class 3 aside alone.The others were all confused, except Lu Yang who knew what was going on.As expected, He Zhentao didn't talk nonsense and got straight to the point and talked about preparing to change the monitor."These days, your class's discipline is loose, your training performance has declined seriously, and your internal hygiene is not up to standard." "You have your own problems, but it is more the responsibility of your squad leader." "This will seriously affect your final assessment results and the assignment of subordinate companies." "So, judging from the current situation, Zhou Kaidong is no longer suitable for the position of squad leader." Hearing these words, the recruits looked at each other in confusion. Didn't they expect that the squad leader could be changed midway?Without giving everyone a chance to discuss or negotiate, He Zhentao directly took out pieces of paper and a handful of black pen refills."Secret voting, check the box if you agree to change the squad leader, or the cross if you don't agree, so there will be no psychological burden." "Yes, the one that passed unanimously?" "No, as long as one person checks the box, after the physical examination is over, Zhou Kaidong can go back to his old army." This voting method was indeed a bit overbearing, and everyone was in trouble all of a sudden.And everyone has different impressions of Zhou Kaidong.Some people feel that he is too strict in training, shouting and behaving rudely at every turn.There are also people who like him who was "amiable" in the past two days and hope to get a monitor who is easy to talk to and can let everyone sleep in.There are also those who think more, thinking that if a new squad leader comes here, will he be worse than Zhou Kaidong?Lu Yang didn't hesitate at all, he directly drew a cross on the note, folded it and handed it to the instructor.He Zhentao was not surprised at all. He also knew that after he left yesterday, this kid must have called Zhou Kaidong to vent his anger.Because on the way here, Gao Feng told him that yesterday Zhou Kaidong went to the duty room to answer a phone call, and when he came back, his attitude suddenly changed 180 degrees.Judging from the time, it was most likely Lu Yang who borrowed someone else's cell phone and called him back.However, He Zhentao was not disgusted by this. He was still thinking about his squad leader even though he was sick, which shows that this soldier is affectionate and righteous.On the contrary, if Lu Yang did nothing, he would feel that this soldier was hot on the outside and cold on the inside, relatively self-centered.However, one person's decision cannot change the overall outcome.The rules were set by him after discussing with the company commander. As long as one person wanted Zhou Kaidong to leave, he had to leave.This was done for the sake of the new recruits in Class Three, and it also happened to resolve the conflict between Zhou Kaidong and Ding Tengfei.He Zhentao collected all the notes, but did not open them immediately. Instead, he put them all in his pocket and asked everyone to go for a physical examination first.This made everyone, including Lu Yang, go crazy.Who can bear it when the answer can be revealed immediately, but they have to come back immediately after making an advertisement?Just like reading novels, some dog authors always like to be distracted at critical moments, making people scratch their hearts."What's the matter? Can't we know the results on site? We have to wait until after the physical examination?" "Hey, you guys are ticking or crossing, but I'm crossing anyway." "Me too, me too, I think our squad leader is actually quite a good person." "What's so good? He's so fierce, what if?It would be nice to have someone as good-tempered as the second squad leader. Who wants to be scolded every day?"" Damn it, you don't know how to check, right?" " Nonsense, I also checked the box!" This is a liar's game. Even if you really check the box, no one will admit it.After being in the army for so many days, everyone is no longer a noob who doesn’t understand anything.Being kicked out by the recruit company means that something has changed in the new training mission, which is a dereliction of duty.In the future, Zhou Kaidong will not be able to participate in merit selection, team retention or promotion; just one ticket can end his career.Even if this kind of thing is really done, you have to deny it, otherwise your spine will be stabbed to pieces.Kong Long came up and asked in a low voice: "Do you think that guy Ding Tengfei can check the box?" Lu Yang shook his head: "It doesn't matter anymore." "Why?" "It's been handed in anyway, so there's no point in discussing it now. Let's look back at the results." "Actually, I quite like Lao Zhou. Although his tactics are really shady, there is nothing wrong with him!" Lu Yang agreed, but not everyone is as they thought.It's hard to reconcile everyone's opinions. Even if you are money, you will encounter people who regard money as dirt.At this time, the three platoon leaders had returned and distributed the physical examination forms they had received.Zhou Kaidong obviously knew what happened, but he still pretended not to know and didn't ask a word.He seemed to have completely looked away, as if he didn't care much about the final result.Ten minutes passed quickly, and the physical examinations of the military families and regiment cadres at the front came to an end, and it was finally their turn for the new recruits.Just as everyone was filing into the building one after another, they suddenly saw a female lieutenant walking out of the medical examination car nearby.This is the first time for everyone to see a female soldier. Although her appearance and temperament are not outstanding, their eyes are still attracted to the female military uniform.Immediately afterwards, he saw the female lieutenant walking up to Gao Feng and patting him lightly on the shoulder.The two of them were talking and laughing, and their relationship was very unusual.Gao Feng also took out hot soy milk and two steamed buns from his arms and handed them over, obviously prepared in advance."Tsk, tsk, tsk, I smell the sour smell of love." "I smell it too." "I really didn't expect that such a domineering person like our company commander is actually a dog." "What kind of dog?" "It's not a stupid dog, it's a licking dog!"
